english_title: Theorem 1.1: Wintner Mean Value Theorem, Early 20th Century
statement_en: If an arithmetic function $f$ is the Dirichlet convolution of $1$ with another arithmetic function $g$, that is, $$f=1*g,$$ and if the series $$\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}$$ converges absolutely, then the mean value $M(f)$ of $f$ exists and equals the sum of that series, namely $$M(f)=\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}.$$
key_techniques: mean value estimation of arithmetic functions
callout_body: 如果算术函数$f$是另外一个算术函数$g$的Dirichlet卷积意义下的和，即$$f=1*g$$并且级数$\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}$绝对收敛，那么$f$的平均值$M(f)$就是该级数收敛到的值,即：$$M(f)=\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}$$
